## Need
Before every release, one command proves that tablet data reaches the API and delta sync returns server changes.

## Success criteria

| id | criterion | sessions | verdict | evidence |
|----|-----------|----------|---------|----------|
| SC0 | WHEN `pnpm release:gate --apk <path> --tier release` runs on the current staging build THE SYSTEM SHALL print `release: PASS` within the release limit of REQ-22 on the registered devices, with every case it runs wired, no open known defect unless waived by name with `--accept-defect`, every `run: manual` case signed for this version, with the APK's body shapes matching the tablet-free suite, and with the latest full-tier verdict of every device case on that APK green or a classed known defect. | S5k, S7a0, S12a, S12b, S7a, S7b, S7c, S7d, S7e, S7f, S7g, S7h, S7i, S7j, S8, S9a, S9b, S10a, S10b, S10c, S11, S11b | | |
| SC1 | WHEN a sync test finishes on the tablet THE SYSTEM SHALL fetch every record the test created, edited or deleted from the staging API and fail the test on any missing or wrong value. | S3, S4, S7a | | |
| SC2 | WHEN the same test runs twice on a freshly reset pool customer THE SYSTEM SHALL give the same pass/fail result both times. | S4, S7a, S11b | | |
| SC3 | WHEN a test ends, pass or fail THE SYSTEM SHALL return its pool customer, and the tablet app, to the reset state. | S3, S4 | | |
| SC4 | WHEN two or more devices run tests at the same time THE SYSTEM SHALL give each its own pool customer, so no test sees another's data. | S1, S6 | MET | `bash checks/dst-s6-SC4-master.sh` exit 0, 2026-11-07 17:31, device-tests 0eedbc3: tablet R8YWA0BTPWH on P1-2 and emulator-5554 on P1-1, overlapping |
| SC5 | WHEN pool customers are built on staging THE SYSTEM SHALL copy the module and permission setups production really uses, taken from the local database. | S1, S12b | | |
| SC6 | WHEN test wiring starts THE SYSTEM SHALL already have a written catalogue of test cases covering every app interaction in sync, permissions, user switching, manage and data entry. | S5a, S5b, S5c, S5d, S5e, S5f, S5g, S5h | | |
| SC7 | WHEN a device sync test syncs THE SYSTEM SHALL compare the requests the tablet logged for that sync with the requests its delta state requires, and fail on a missing, extra or wrong request. | S4b, S7a | | |
| SC8 | WHEN the delta contract suite runs THE SYSTEM SHALL check, with no tablet, that each write made through the API is counted once, delivered by its window, and not counted again. | S3b | MET | `checks/dst-s3b-SC8.sh` exit 0 printed `SC8 met: 72 tests, 10 known defects` on staging, device-tests `70a6fa7`, 2026-11-07 |
| SC9 | WHEN delta case authoring ends THE SYSTEM SHALL have a case for every app trap D1–D13 in `evidence/delta-mobile.md` and every server mismatch in `evidence/delta-api.md`. | S5i | | |
| SC10 | WHEN production sync patterns are mined THE SYSTEM SHALL hold a case at or above the observed per-sync maximum for each entity and operation, and a case for each module configuration seen. | S5j, S5d, S12a, S12b | | |
| SC11 | WHEN the nightly timer fires THE SYSTEM SHALL run the release tier and one part of the full device tier on the candidate in `reports/candidate.json`, plus the whole tablet-free suite, and record each verdict with the APK sha256 and server commit, so every device case runs at least once per cycle of parts. | S11, S11b | | |
| SC12 | WHEN the tablet-free suite runs THE SYSTEM SHALL send the tablet's own upload and delta requests as a slot user with source `mobile_app` for every entity and operation, at every volume up to the production maximum and for every profile P1–P9, and fail on a body whose shape differs from the tablet's own request. | S12a, S12b | | |
| SC13 | WHEN `pnpm catalogue:disposition --check` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL fail while any written case lacks a run (device, api, or excluded with a reason) or lacks an owner session that is a row of this plan. | S5k | MET | `checks/dst-s5k-SC13.sh` exit 0 printed `SC13 met: 218 device, 136 api, every owner count matches, an unowned case exits 1`, device-tests `fbac48a`, 2026-11-07 |
| SC14 | WHEN `pnpm suite:budget` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL fail when the release tier or one night's run exceeds its limit in REQ-22 on the registered devices. | S5k, S11 | | |

| SC15 | WHEN `pnpm pool:coverage` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL map all 228 active stores to a profile, or name each store left out and its reason (QA-only modules). | S1b | MET | `bash checks/dst-s1b-SC15.sh` exit 0, 2026-11-07: `225/228 mapped; 3 left out` (stores 617, 618, 619, QA-only modules); device-tests d391bbe |
| SC16 | WHEN `pnpm release:gate --prod-apk <path>` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL fail unless the production APK differs from the tested staging APK only in package id, server address, app name and signing, and a read-only production login sync passes on it. | S11c | | |
| SC17 | WHEN the release tier runs THE SYSTEM SHALL run it on a production-model tablet (SM-T500 or SM-T510) as well as the reference device. | S6b, S11 | | |
